text: With that peculiar woman, that saxophone, with that peculiar groanin', they're playin' songs, just feel that drum, don't you think that music's right? Something they do I never knew, just makes me feel oh so good that I can throw myself away. Hey, Suser, give me the dance, when they play that rhythm of mine,
